newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends mixed, gains late on CBOT.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends mixed, gains late on CBOT.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures closed mixed with the market firming late on a rally in CBOT wheat, traders said.
"It was very, very light with a little intramarket spreading and it got a little boost from Chicago," a trader said.
Traders said there was a light amount of intramarket spreading with Continental Grain buying MGE July and selling KCBT July.
Gains were limited on ideas that U.S. spring wheat seedings proceeded at a rapid pace last week.
USDA late Monday will release its updated weekly state crop reports which will include the spring wheat seeding pace in the U.S.
Pressure also came from rainfall over the weekend in the U.S. Great Plains which hit the KCBT hard red winter wheat futures market.
MGE spring wheat futures closed 1/2 cent lower to 3/4 higher, with July down 1/2 at $4.14-3/4.
MGE barley futures closed unchanged with July at $6.70 per cwt.
